notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’ve added a new level selection screen based on your requests. Now you can easily go back and replay levels you’ve completed. We also added a quick button to switch between single-player and two-player modes. This means you can play one level alone and bring a friend for the next one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342928/a1f64741bdf494e14f40ab519dbe2580745fa49d.png[/img]

We’ve made some changes to the secret ducks and limited the number of hints you can use. We also reduced extra text in the game—many menu options are now shown as icons.

Thanks for your support! We’re still working on more updates. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.content:
[b]And here is the early access release![/b]
We invite you to find all of our ducks. Will you succeed?

Thank you to everyone who helped us during development, to people who waited for the game, and to everyone who played the demo and provided valuable feedback. 

We always happy receiving new feedback and ready to continue improving the game!

Good duck!

notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We're back with exciting updates from the beach level in our game. We've been hard at work, creating a bunch of new delightful pixelated objects. But that's not all – we also hid 42 more ducks for you to find. Can you spot them all?
